verification_report.summary: The reconstruction is correct relative to the stated accepted classical/internal inputs. The closed-form and bar-partial-exact definitions agree; strongly Gauduchon implies Gauduchon and includes the balanced case; the displayed d^c primitive has the correct sign, normalization, degree, and reality; the forward current obstruction is valid; and the converse Hahn--Banach argument correctly uses the full real smooth-form space to force type (1,1), extends positivity to semipositive tests, and uses annihilation of all closed complementary forms to deduce de Rham exactness. The pseudoeffective Bott--Chern reformulation is also equivalent, since a positive representative of the zero Bott--Chern class vanishes by pairing with a Gauduchon form. The cited arXiv statements match the terminology and conclusions, but the proof is independently reconstructed rather than imported.
